checkpoint_identity.value: Fixed-resolution ViT-B/16 at 256px. For SigLIP 2 the README names the downloadable checkpoint siglip2_b16_256.npz for the B/16 @ 256 row, and the paper table identifies the model as SigLIP 2, ViT B/16, Res. 256, Seq. 256. For the original SigLIP there is a matching table row (SigLIP, B/16, 256, 256) but no checkpoint filename/link is given in the local sources.

architecture_resolution.value: Standard fixed-resolution ViT architecture with learned positional embedding and MAP (attention pooling) head; patch size 16 and image resolution 256 (image representation sequence length 256).

text_tokenizer_normalization.value: Multilingual Gemma tokenizer, vocabulary size 256k, text length 64, text transformed to lower case before tokenization.

image_preprocessing.value: Paper states default fixed-resolution variants use non-aspect preserving resize to 256px; exact evaluation resizing/cropping/interpolation/normalization is not specified.

imagenet1k_evaluation.value: Zero-shot classification accuracy on ImageNet-1k validation for fixed-resolution B/16 @ 256; exact prompt templates are not stated.

coco_retrieval_evaluation.value: Table reports COCO T->I and I->T recall@1; exact split, candidate pool, and retrieval/scoring procedure are not described.

metric_definitions.value: ImageNet-1k uses top-1 zero-shot classification accuracy; COCO uses recall@1 in both directions.
